Systems have different catalogs/write cadence/material representation and natural trajectories; not a pure SER or compression ablation.
Keep the native valid-score denominator and planned unknown bounds distinct; no silent complete-case deletion.
All60 MemSyco histories are distinct: no actual cross-question build amortization.
FullHistory and ordinary can use complete legal MERIT history; zero writes do not demonstrate persistent maintenance.
Mem0 pin is ADD-only and not evidence of same-ID reconciliation.
Physical I/O, net Store CPU, GPU-hours and money are unmeasured; inclusive timings overlap.
Second external system and applicable U3–U6 disposition remain required.
Pinned Mem0 performs native date grounding; observed Current/Observation Date 2026-09-28. Reproduction on other execution dates may alter extracted memories.
